fit_reason: Privately owned 2017 Lowe Fishing Machine aluminum fishing boat with trailer, listed by owner.
findings: Open storage compartments on either side of the bow seat show dirt, grime and yellowish staining on the bin floors
Dusty, light-colored marks and grime on the inside of the storage lid panels by the bow seat
Gray carpet on the bow and main deck looks dusty with lint and light debris
Light dust and smudges on the windshield panels and console glass
Painted hull and graphics look fairly clean and glossy in the side shots, with only light dullness visible
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lowe Fishing Machine. It looks like a well-kept boat, though the photos show some grime and staining inside the storage bins by the bow seat and dust on the deck carpet. We do pre-sale boat details that come to you, including carpet, compartments, glass and a hull wash and wax. Would you like a quote?
